description: This is a test class for RetrieveAclResponse, a part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It focuses on testing the behavior, immutability, equality, and JSON serialization/deserialization of the RetrieveAclResponse class.

classes.name: RetrieveAclResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing RetrieveAclResponse, including immutability, equality, null checks, JSON serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveAclResponse instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAcl
methods.description: Checks that creating a RetrieveAclResponse with a null ACL throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that creating a RetrieveAclResponse with a null JsonObject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a RetrieveAclResponse instance from JSON and verifies its contents.
